methodology: MiniWoB upstream tasks, seeds 101/202, 120-second episode budget, max four trusted clicks. Full rendered-DOM+controls versus controls-only observation. Same planner and current goal/history. Context arm adds selected state and last three verified clicks to Jev, then falls back to the same planner. A post-action observation checks for an effect before retaining history. Exact fixture target, live geometry and label rechecked before clicks. Reward globals read only by evaluator. Not an official MiniWoB score. Model calls use a fresh Codex CLI process; timings include startup and network.
limits: Six episodes per arm; sequential batches, not evidence of a general speedup.
Actual Puppet HTTP MCP and resident CDP on an existing Chrome profile. Observer is the experimental rendered-DOM adapter, not production Accessibility collection.
Planner timings include a fresh Codex CLI process and network. Jev timings include network; 0.9 confidence gate and 1.5s deadline unchanged.
Context arm changes chooser instructions as well as state/history; their individual effects are not isolated.
Context arm adds a post-action observation before recording a verified action; clickAndScore excludes that extra observation, totalMs includes it.
Evaluator reward state never enters model prompts. No native Frame timing or Codex built-in browser comparison in these arms.
The local exploratory runners and fixture server remain outside the repository; this artifact preserves measurements, not a portable live benchmark.
